provenance.dimension_basis: manufacturer model overall and cavity dimensions
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

review.frame_coverage: 1990 retained source frames at 30000/1001 fps in 16 camera segments. Logo-only and pure white frames 118, 119, 223, 1998 excluded; faint visible-model transition frames retained. Both compressed videos decode to the same 1990 frames.
review.visual_review: All 8 encoded shot boards and all 15 additional encoded opening/anchor frames inspected. The opening edge follows source frames 492-496; hidden opening completion at 497-501 is inferred. Camera movement is tracked per source frame; occluded or low-texture gaps use recorded inference.
review.revision: Native v072: rounded flush door and recessed charcoal control membrane, broad handle, detailed printed keys, continuous rounded cabinet/cavity, tapered front aperture, left liner vent, stepped side pressings, adjusted latch receivers, and state-dependent internal lamp.
review.mechanics: Single left hinge. Five blurred source free-edge observations have median line residuals of about 2.3-14.6 pixels at source resolution. Cropped static cavity angles and hidden joint construction are inferred.
review.geometry: Native v072 cabinet manifold, positive volume, independent door, 2.2 mm membrane recess, and feet checks passed. Structural door surfaces clear at 22 sampled angles from 0 to 180 degrees; hinge and latch engagement excluded. This is not continuous clearance or force verification.
review.alignment_limit: Not pixel-perfect. Tight liner macros retain visible perspective and pressed-contour differences; some calibration landmarks have residuals near 100 source pixels. Focus pulls, motion blur, logo artwork, material reflections and source title/fade effects are not reproduced exactly. People, food and the filming environment are outside the accepted scope.
review.scene: Frozen Tangyuan kitchen and shared external product lighting. The internal lamp power is a visual estimate, not an OEM rating.
